final: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS phase_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth), SUM(p.phase_count), AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - x.mean_phase_avg) FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS x WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > x.mean_phase_avg
